events.speaker: DELIA
events.text: I'm mending fence on the line, not looking at your outfit. Say what you're going to say, but don't ask me to badmouth the people still signing my pay.

events.speaker: DELIA
events.text: I watched the whole trade, start to finish, and nobody got shorted a thing. Hargrove's never once shown me that. I don't forget a thing like that.

events.speaker: DELIA
events.text: You never once asked me to say a bad word about the family that raised me on that spread. I'm riding with people who deal fair. That's the whole decision.

events.speaker: DELIA
events.text: I'm slow to trust and I know it. But I've decided about you already, and I don't take that back once it's said.
